customMethods.name: formatData

transforms.code:
if value is None: return None
	
	data = system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(value))
	
	breakpointIds = {}
	breakpoints = {}
	
	for breakpoint in data['breakpoints'].values():
		oldKey = 'b{:}'.format(breakpoint['id'])
		newId = str(system.kanoa.utilities.numbers.getUUID())
		breakpoint['id'] = newId
		breakpoint['state'] = 'new'
		
		newKey = 'b' + newId
		breakpointIds[oldKey] = newId
		breakpoints[newKey] = breakpoint
	
	data['breakpoints'] = breakpoints
	
	widgetIds = {}
	widgets = {}
	
	for widget in data['widgets'].values():
		oldKey = 'w{:}'.format(widget['id'])
		newId = str(system.kanoa.utilities.numbers.getUUID())
		widget['id'] = newId
		widget['state'] = 'new'
		
		newKey = 'w' + newId
		widgetIds[oldKey] = newId
		widgets[newKey] = widget
		
		for param in widget['params']:
			param['id'] = str(system.kanoa.utilities.numbers.getUUID())
			param['state'] = 'new'
	
	data['widgets'] = widgets
	
	positions = {}
	
	for position in data['positions'].values():
		newId = str(system.kanoa.utilities.numbers.getUUID())
		position['id'] = newId
		position['state'] = 'new'
		
		bKey = 'b{:}'.format(position['breakpointId'])
		wKey = 'w{:}'.format(position['widgetId'])
		
		position['breakpointId'] = breakpointIds[bKey]
		position['widgetId'] = widgetIds[wKey]
		newKey = 'b{:}_w{:}'.format(position['breakpointId'], position['widgetId'])
		positions[newKey] = position
	
	data['positions'] = positions
	
	data['id'] = str(system.kanoa.utilities.numbers.getUUID())
	data['state'] = 'new'
	
	return data

document = value or None
	
	if document is None: return None
	
	import java.lang
	
	try:

		data = dict(system.util.jsonDecode(document))
	except java.lang.Exception, e:
		system.perspective.print("exception found %s"%e.cause)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'The json in this file is not formatted correctly. %s'%e.cause})				
	except:
		system.perspective.print("exception found")
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'The json in this file is not formatted correctly'})
		data = None
	
	return data
